messages:
Alex Chen: Quick check — EdgeProxy + airgapped customer (HelixHealth) cutover is this Thursday. Are we green on egress IPs and certs? 
Samir Patel: Working on egress list, netops asked for final IPs by EOD today. I have most, missing one CIDR from customer.
Jia Li: I have the cert rotation steps ready, question: will the customer accept ACME-signed certs or do we need to upload their signed cert bundle? 
Maria Gomez: Helix said they require org-signed certs (no public ACME). Customer will provide PKCS12. Netops will import.
netops-bot: Reminder: run `egress-prober --target helixhealth --ports 443,80` after NAT rule changes. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: Samir confirm CIDR (A), Jia confirm import steps and timeline (B), Maria confirm customer PKCS12 upload window (C). 
Samir Patel: Confirmed CIDR x.x.240.0/24 — added to spreadsheet. Pinged customer for confirmation. :white_check_mark:
Jia Li: Import steps: 
```
# on jumpbox
openssl pkcs12 -in helix.p12 -nodes -out helix.pem
kubectl create secret tls helix-cert --cert=helix.pem --key=helix.key -n redwood-edge
``` 
Will need a 30-min maintenance window for rolling proxies.
Maria Gomez: Customer can upload PKCS12 Wed 22:00 UTC. They asked for a short window with engineers present. I'll schedule.
Alex Chen: Does this require a CR for proxy config? I thought we could patch via canary.
Samir Patel: We'll need CR for NAT and egress ACLs. Low-risk change but ops policy needs CR with reviewer @netops.
Jia Li: OK — I'll prepare the proxy patch and canary rollout steps in PR. Need repo + branch owner.
Alex Chen: Repo: infra/edge-proxy, branch `helix/egress-rollout`. Samir can be CR owner, Jia owns PR content, Maria will coordinate customer timing.
netops-bot: CR created: CR-4827 by Samir Patel — reviewers: netops-team, eng-platform. Link: https://redwood.internal/crs/4827
Samir Patel: FYI tests to run post-change: `egress-prober`, `tls-handshake-check --host helix.customer`, and smoke chat requests. I'll add to PR description.
Maria Gomez: I'll block 22:00-22:45 UTC Wed on calendars and add customer dial-in.
Alex Chen: One more: airgap artifact sync — is image signing complete? last check showed 2 images unsigned.
Jia Li: Fixed — images signed and synced to offline registry at 1779994000. I pushed the checksum to the runbook.
Alex Chen: Great. Owners: Samir (CIDR + CR), Jia (certs + images + PR), Maria (customer schedule). I'll ping on Thurs morning for final go/no-go.
Samir Patel: Sounds good. If CIDR confirmation delayed, fallback plan: use temporary NAT on standby and postpone proxy roll.
Maria Gomez: Noted. :thumbsup:
netops-bot: Scheduled: egress-prober run at 1779995600. Results will be posted in this thread.
Samir Patel: Received prober results — all green except one path through PoP-3. Looking into routing to PoP-4.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — moving to async updates. Post final readiness by 1779995800 so we can lock the CR.
